title: The only World Cup final decided by VAR

scenes.voiceover: And number one. Moscow. The 2018 FINAL. France one, Croatia one — and Griezmann's corner brushes Perisic's hand. The referee says nothing. Then VAR calls him to the screen.
scenes.mainText: ① A FINAL DECIDED BY A SCREEN

scenes.voiceover: Penalty. Griezmann scores. Croatia never recover, France win four-two. Roy Keane said the decision quote, disgusts me. Modric said you cannot give that in a final. It is still the only World Cup final swung by a VAR call.
scenes.kicker: THE ONLY FINAL VAR EVER DECIDED

scenes.voiceover: With the quarterfinals starting July ninth, VAR will decide someone's World Cup again — probably this week. Subscribe so you get the breakdown when it happens, and tell me which call still makes you angry.

title: Argentina had 3 goals erased by armpit offsides

scenes.voiceover: Number four. Qatar, 2022. Argentina versus Saudi Arabia. THREE first-half Argentina goals disallowed — Messi once, Lautaro Martínez twice — by the new semi-automated offside system, some by the width of a shoulder.

Twenty-nine tracking points per player. A sensor in the ball pinging five hundred times a second. Goals erased by margins no human eye can see — and Saudi Arabia pulled off one of the biggest upsets ever, two-one.

With the quarterfinals starting July ninth, VAR will decide someone's World Cup again — probably this week. Subscribe so you get the breakdown when it happens, and tell me which call still makes you angry.
